isa.title: KAD Compute Fabric Ideal State Artifact (ISA)

claims.statement: Meaningful compute state transitions emit typed PON notifications rather than relying on active polling.
claims.evidence: PON typed notification contract codified in PRIME_DIRECTIVE.md and implemented in tools/kad/pon-engine.mjs

claims.statement: Tasks request spatial capability contracts (cognition, quality, context) rather than hardcoded machine identities.
claims.evidence: Tasks request spatial capability contracts via resource-contract.mjs and economic-router.mjs without machine identity coupling

claims.statement: Local models, runtimes, and worker processes enforce explicit temporal lifecycle ownership and LIFO teardown.
claims.evidence: Explicit worker/runtime lifecycle ownership and LIFO teardown enforced in tools/kad/swarm-workers.mjs

claims.statement: Route promotion requires local empirical evidence; theoretical capability creates a hypothesis only.
claims.evidence: Route promotion strictly gated on append-only empirical observatory journal and readiness verifier

claims.statement: Capability degradation gracefully steps through lower tiers without silently escalating authority or spend.
claims.evidence: Economic router enforces fail-safe downward degradation hierarchy across EXECUTION_CLASSES

claims.statement: System optimizes for useful work per scarce resource used and rejects ungrounded token generation (TOKENMAXXING).
claims.evidence: Objective function accepted_useful_work / scarce_resources_used implemented in telemetry/tokenmaxxing.mjs

claims.statement: Heterogeneous host definitions (AMDY vs TELL) adapt into canonical capability contracts without OS leakage.
claims.evidence: AMDY (Omarchy 4) and TELL (NixOS) host definitions adapt into canonical capability contracts without OS leakage

claims.statement: Ten distinct capability-oriented cognition classes define task classification and routing contracts.
claims.evidence: All 10 standardized capability-oriented cognition classes defined in compute fabric ISA

claims.statement: Inference execution configurations are evaluated against the 9-dimensional experimental tuple schema.
claims.evidence: Experimental 9-tuple schema and 11 telemetry metrics codified in compute fabric ISA

claims.statement: Repeated accepted probabilistic work generates candidates for downward distillation and deterministic replacement.
claims.evidence: Repeated accepted probabilistic work generates candidates for deterministic or smaller model migration via distillation.mjs

claims.statement: Presentation, observation, and telemetry layers have zero direct mutation authority over compute routing state.
claims.evidence: Compute fabric observation and presentation planes isolated from direct un-gated mutation

claims.statement: Canonical compute fabric architecture and self-measuring governance approved by Human Project Lead.
claims.evidence: Target state governed by Human Project Lead and canonical KAD Architecture (WP-020)

amdy.role: control plane / primary inference experiment / workstation
